description: This file provides mock implementations of functions related to package management, such as updating, installing, comparing versions, and cleanup operations, for testing purposes.

methods.name: opkg_update_package_lists
methods.description: Mock function to simulate updating package lists, takes a progress callback and user data.

methods.name: opkg_install_package
methods.description: Mock function to simulate installing a package given its URL, with a progress callback and user data.

methods.name: opkg_conf_deinit
methods.description: Mock function to deinitialize or clean up configuration.

methods.name: opkg_compare_versions
methods.description: Mock function to compare two version strings.

methods.name: opkg_upgrade_package
methods.description: Mock function to simulate upgrading a package by name, with a callback and user data.

methods.name: opkg_new
methods.description: Mock function to initialize or create a new package management context.

methods.name: opkg_download_cleanup
methods.description: Mock function to clean up after downloads.

methods.name: opkg_list_upgradable_packages
methods.description: Mock function to list all upgradable packages, takes a callback and user data.
